title: Invisible icon in "General Configuration" preview with mixed light/dark theme like Breeze Twilight
line: With a dark Plasma style and light app colours (Breeze Twilight), the launcher icon preview in Kickoff and Kicker settings is now light on the dark panel graphic instead of nearly invisible.
explanation: The icon preview in the Kickoff and Kicker settings draws the launcher icon on a Plasma panel/background graphic, which follows the Plasma style, but the icon itself takes its colour from the settings window, which follows the application colour scheme. With Breeze Twilight (dark Plasma style, light app colours) the symbolic icon is dark grey on a dark grey frame. The open MRs add a small LauncherTheme singleton to the Kicker QML backend exposing the Plasma theme's text colour (plasma-workspace!7357) and bind both preview icons to it (plasma-desktop!4177).

patches.diff:
From 91fddfd5b9d848e1f6c7b27452b762c7caeb12f0 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Peder Bergan <contact@pederbe.dev>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 22:46:48 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] Use Plasma text colors for launcher icon previews

The Kickoff and Kicker icon previews use Plasma backgrounds but inherit
application text colors. With Breeze Twilight, this draws dark symbolic
icons on a dark background.

Bind both preview icons to Kicker.LauncherTheme.textColor from
plasma-workspace!7357. The shared singleton follows Plasma theme changes
while keeping the color override local to each preview.

BUG: 525301
---
 applets/kicker/ConfigGeneral.qml  | 3 +++
 applets/kickoff/ConfigGeneral.qml | 3 +++
 2 files changed, 6 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/kicker/ConfigGeneral.qml b/applets/kicker/ConfigGeneral.qml
index 673855d546..b46971549b 100644
--- a/applets/kicker/ConfigGeneral.qml
+++ b/applets/kicker/ConfigGeneral.qml
@@ -14,6 +14,7 @@ import org.kde.kcmutils as KCMUtils
 import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
 import org.kde.ksvg as KSvg
 import org.kde.plasma.core as PlasmaCore
+import org.kde.plasma.private.kicker as Kicker
 import org.kde.plasma.plasmoid
 
 KCMUtils.SimpleKCM {
@@ -121,6 +122,8 @@ KCMUtils.SimpleKCM {
                     width: Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.large
                     height: width
                     source: configGeneral.cfg_useCustomButtonImage ? configGeneral.cfg_customButtonImage : configGeneral.cfg_icon
+
+                    Kirigami.Theme.textColor: Kicker.LauncherTheme.textColor
                 }
             }
 
diff --git a/applets/kickoff/ConfigGeneral.qml b/applets/kickoff/ConfigGeneral.qml
index 025cba4c49..f42449174a 100644
--- a/applets/kickoff/ConfigGeneral.qml
+++ b/applets/kickoff/ConfigGeneral.qml
@@ -14,6 +14,7 @@ import QtQuick.Layouts
 import QtQuick.Controls as QQC2
 
 import org.kde.plasma.core as PlasmaCore
+import org.kde.plasma.private.kicker as Kicker
 import org.kde.ksvg as KSvg
 import org.kde.iconthemes as KIconThemes
 import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
@@ -80,6 +81,8 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
                     width: Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.large
                     height: width
                     source: Tools.iconOrDefault(Plasmoid.formFactor, root.cfg_icon)
+
+                    Kirigami.Theme.textColor: Kicker.LauncherTheme.textColor
                 }
             }
 
-- 
2.53.0

From b74647cc95093cebcc5d796b2de2e5833f151f16 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Peder Bergan <contact@pederbe.dev>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:57:46 +0000
Subject: [PATCH 1/2] kicker: expose Plasma text color through a launcher theme
 singleton

Keep the launcher configuration palette workaround in the shared backend.
Expose the existing Plasma foreground getter and themeChanged notification.

See plasma/plasma-desktop!4177.
---
 applets/kicker/launchertheme.h | 26 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 1 file changed, 26 insertions(+)
 create mode 100644 applets/kicker/launchertheme.h

diff --git a/applets/kicker/launchertheme.h b/applets/kicker/launchertheme.h
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..3d94918a0e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/applets/kicker/launchertheme.h
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
+// SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Peder Bergan <pederbe@users.noreply.github.com>
+
+#pragma once
+
+#include <Plasma/Theme>
+#include <qqmlregistration.h>
+
+class LauncherTheme : public Plasma::Theme
+{
+    Q_OBJECT
+    QML_ELEMENT
+    QML_SINGLETON
+    Q_PROPERTY(QColor textColor READ textColor NOTIFY themeChanged FINAL)
+
+public:
+    explicit LauncherTheme(QObject *parent = nullptr)
+        : Plasma::Theme(parent)
+    {
+    }
+
+    QColor textColor() const
+    {
+        return color(Plasma::Theme::TextColor);
+    }
+};
--
